lede: LSU carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.0 against +5.4, a 3.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Ole Miss -8.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ole Miss winning 71% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is kicking, where Ole Miss leads LSU by 57 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
